column5: Though, how tragic for the audience, and how dull for our dear clown, that their emotions have been stripped from them
Ah, like that they would hardly be able to make anyone laugh, or even shed a tear.
Now, before I become any more tragic like you, could you explain how they may solve this dire situation?
It will be a trial, a terrible climb, twice to the top of this very tent, [where they run, and jump, and float], and which I had desired they do it alone.
But such dreariness could never bring about joy for the audience.
not everyone desires joy” *ahem* “And so you, dear audience member –yes you, will need to help them.
And to start you will make a choice on whose trial to complete first.
